title: Maria and the Bread
text:
Maria is at the shop. "Hello! I want bread, please," she says. "Here you are," says the man. "Thank you!" says Maria.

Now Maria is at home. She eats the bread. "It is good!" she says. Her cat wants some too.

questions.text: Where is Maria at the start of the story?
What does Maria eat at home?
How does Maria feel about the bread?
Why does the cat probably want some bread?
options: The cat does not like food

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things
food made from flour and water, baked in an oven

paragraph_translations: Maria está na loja. "Olá! Eu quero pão, por favor", diz ela. "Aqui está", diz o homem. "Obrigada!", diz Maria.
Agora Maria está em casa. Ela come o pão. "É bom!", diz ela. O gato dela também quer um pouco.
